title: English Practice Quiz 0441
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A synonym of 'begin' is ___.
questions.explanation: Start has the same basic meaning as begin.

questions.question: She is ___ university student.
questions.explanation: University begins with the consonant sound /y/, so use a.

questions.question: ___ I borrow your pen, please?
questions.explanation: May is a polite way to ask permission.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Use there are with plural nouns.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'light'?
questions.explanation: Light and night share the same ending sound.

questions.question: You need to report a problem. You say:
options: There is an issue with the printer.
questions.explanation: There is an issue with... clearly introduces a problem.

questions.question: Which sentence uses the apostrophe correctly?
options: The guards' uniform is blue. (one guard)
questions.explanation: Guard's shows possession by one guard.

questions.question: If it rains, we ___ indoors.
questions.explanation: The first conditional uses if + present simple, will + base verb.

questions.question: The windows ___ every week.
questions.explanation: Plural subject windows takes are + past participle.

questions.question: There is ___ water in the bottle.
questions.explanation: A little is used with uncountable nouns.
